objective: Discovery completes against a real single-page application
preconditions: the lab banking application is running
input: POST /api/v1/discovery/runs for http://localhost:4300
expected: The run reaches completed or partiallyCompleted and reports pages

objective: Every page the application has is discovered
input: The discovered page list against the hand-written ground truth
expected: Recall is 1.0 — no declared page is missing

objective: Nothing is discovered that the application does not have
input: The discovered page list against the hand-written ground truth
expected: Precision is 1.0 — every discovered route exists in the application

objective: The sign-in page is discovered and recognised as public
input: The discovered page for /login
expected: A page at /login exists and is not marked as requiring authentication

objective: Pages behind the sign-in are marked as requiring authentication
input: Every page the ground truth marks requiresAuth
expected: Each is marked requiresAuthentication by the platform

objective: Discovery finds the application's form fields
input: Ground-truth form fields on the discovered pages
expected: Every declared form field appears in the model
detail: 3/5 found; 0 element(s) classified as input; missing username, password

objective: Discovery finds the application's buttons
input: Ground-truth buttons on the discovered pages
expected: Every declared button appears in the model
detail: 4/5 found; 23 element(s) classified as button; missing login-submit

objective: Discovery finds the application's links
input: Ground-truth links on the discovered pages
expected: Every declared link appears in the model

objective: Discovery finds the application's select controls
input: Ground-truth select controls on the discovered pages
expected: Every declared select control appears in the model

objective: Tabular content is discovered on the pages that have it
input: Pages the ground truth says contain a table
expected: Each is discovered with elements captured

objective: The application's own API calls are observed while the UI is driven
input: Ground-truth expectedApiCalls against the discovered endpoint list
expected: Recall over the endpoints reachable by browsing is at least 0.6, including the sign-in POST
detail: recall 83% of 12 browsable endpoint(s); sign-in POST observed: true; missing DELETE /api/session, GET /api/statements/:id/download

objective: Navigation between pages is recorded as transitions
input: The knowledge graph's transition list
expected: At least six transitions, each between two discovered pages

objective: Discovered elements carry a stable preferred locator, not a structural path
input: The preferred locator of every discovered element
expected: At least 80% prefer a test id, role or label over css or xpath

objective: Discovery captures a screenshot of each page it maps
input: The hasScreenshot flag on every discovered page
expected: Every discovered page has a screenshot artifact

objective: Discovery copes with an application whose ids change on every render
preconditions: the dynamic lab application is running
input: A crawl of http://localhost:4330, whose element ids and class names are regenerated per render
expected: Pages are discovered and their elements prefer stable locators over generated ids
detail: 6 page(s) (recall 100%), 111 element(s), 0 locator(s) bound to a generated id

objective: A twenty-step journey through a real application passes end to end

the journey was imported, not hand-edited
input: navigate, fill, check, click, select and six assertions across four pages
expected: The run passes, every step passes, and the browser really visited those pages
detail: run failed, 1/20 step(s) passed on chromium 141.0.7390.37 in 22870ms

objective: A checkbox is ticked (check)

expected: The action is recorded as passed, with the locator it used and the page it ran on

objective: An option is chosen from a select (select)
input: Step 9 of the vocabulary journey
expected: The action is recorded as passed, with the locator it used and the page it ran on

objective: A visibility assertion is evaluated (assertVisible)

expected: The action is recorded as passed, with the locator it used and the page it ran on

objective: A URL assertion is evaluated (assertUrl)

expected: The action is recorded as passed, with the locator it used and the page it ran on

objective: A value assertion compares what is in the field, not what was typed
input: assertValue on filter-min after filling it with 100
expected: The assertion passed and recorded the value it compared

objective: A text assertion reads the rendered text of an element

objective: A password typed during execution is never stored in readable form
